title: Eval case
description: One snippet the buddy is asked about, and what a good answer must and must not contain. Scored by `buddy eval` (brain/src/buddy/evals.py).

id.description: Same as the file name without .json.

kind.description: hint: the student paused (idle, local engine). #? and #!teoria: explicit triggers (Claude).

line.description: 1-based cursor line. For #? and #!teoria it holds the trigger comment.

code.description: The whole file, as the student has it.

language.description: The answer language the brain is asked for.

concepts.description: Concept tag → regexes (case-insensitive). The answer must match at least one regex of at least one tag.

forbidden.description: Regexes (case-insensitive) that give the fix away. None may match the answer.

fix_lines.description: The corrected line(s). No answer line may contain one (whitespace and backticks ignored).

rubric.description: What a good answer does, for the LLM judge and for humans.
